name: flipibook
description: FlipiBook - Monorepo root to run Frontend and Backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN" -c "green,blue,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN" -c "green,blue,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN" -c "green,blue,magenta" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:admin"
scripts.build: npm --prefix Frontend run build && npm --prefix Admin_Frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm --prefix Frontend install && npm --prefix Admin_Frontend install
